Name: Kent and Sandy Friendship Boost
Author: Moralle
Description:
Have you ever felt annoyed at having to build up friendship with Sandy or Kent once you meet them well into your playthrough? I have, so I made this simple mod to fix that.

For Kent, the friendship points (heart level times 250) of Jodi, Sam, and Vincent get added together and then divided by 4. If you're best friends with his family, it would only make sense for him to have a good first impression of you.

For Sandy, Emily's friendship points get divided by 1.5. She does receive letters about what happens in Stardew Valley, including your farmer's activity. If you're nice to Emily, Sandy has probably read about it.

For example, if you had 8 hearts with Sam, 4 with Vincent, and 3 with Jodi, your friendship with Kent would start out with 4 hearts. And if you had 6 hearts with Emily, your relationship with Sandy would start with 4 hearts as well.

There is no config provided, but the mod is so small that you can just change the content.json itself to tweak the calculation to your heart's content.

This mod is incompatible with any mods that change Kent's or Sandy's first-meeting events, since the friendship boost is provided through those. For the same reason, this mod doesn't do anything if you've already met them in your save.
